Create a (stratified) permuted block randomisation list

createRandoList.Rd

Creates a block randomisation list with random block lengths, optionally stratified and with permuted patient identifiers. This is a revision of the legacy createRandoListNew.R function: for the same seed and arguments it returns the same list (the random numbers are drawn in the same order), but it fixes a bug in the permutation of patient IDs, restores the caller's random number generator settings, validates its inputs and records how the list was made.

Usage

createRandoList(nPat, arms = 2, arm_names = LETTERS[seq_len(arms)],
  strata = c(HTD = "001"), blocklength = arms * (2:3),
  blocklength_prob = rep(1/length(blocklength), length(blocklength)),
  first_patid = 1,
  patid_format = list(flag = "0", width = nchar(max(nPat + first_patid - 1))),
  n.block_permute = 0, RanNo_pattern = "{stratum}-{pat_id}", seed = NULL,
  sample_kind = c("Rounding", "Rejection"), seed_per_stratum = FALSE)

Arguments

nPat

Number of patients per stratum: a single number used for every stratum, or one number per stratum. The SOP asks for at least twice the maximum anticipated stratum size. Strata with 0 patients return NULL.

arms

Number of arms (at least 2).

arm_names

Arm labels, one per arm. For a dummy list use dummy_arm_names. If NULL, arms are called Arm1, Arm2, ...

strata

Named vector of strata: names are the stratum names, values the stratum codes used in the randomisation number. See composite_strata.

blocklength

Possible block lengths; each must be a multiple of arms.

blocklength_prob

Probability of each block length. The default (equal probabilities) is kept for compatibility with the legacy function; the SOP default is c(0.75, 0.25), so pass it explicitly.

first_patid

Patient number of the first patient in each stratum.

patid_format

List of formatC arguments used to format patient numbers, or NULL to keep them unformatted.

n.block_permute

Permute patient numbers within every n.block_permute consecutive blocks; 0 (default) means no permutation and Inf one permutation of the whole stratum. See Details.

RanNo_pattern

Pattern of the randomisation number using columns of the output in braces, e.g. "\{stratum\}-\{pat_id\}". NULL for none.

seed

Optional seed. If given, the generator is set with set.seed(seed, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion", sample.kind = sample_kind), which gives the same list as calling set.seed(seed) before the function. If NULL, a seed must already have been set.

sample_kind

"Rounding" (default, as in the legacy function and in R < 3.6.0) or "Rejection" (R's current default). Both are reproducible; use the same value for the dummy and the final list.

seed_per_stratum

If TRUE, stratum i is generated with seed seed + i - 1, so that changing the size of one stratum does not change the others. Requires seed. Lists differ from the legacy function in this mode.

Details

Within each block, every arm occurs equally often (permuted block design); the block length is drawn from blocklength with blocklength_prob. The list is cut at nPat, so the last block of a stratum may be incomplete.

With n.block_permute > 0 the patient numbers are shuffled within groups of blocks while the order of arms stays the same. Balance at the end of each block then holds in the order of the rows, not in the order of the patient numbers. If patients are enrolled in increasing randomisation number, balance is only guaranteed at the end of each group of n.block_permute blocks.

The caller's sample.kind is restored on exit, also after an error.

Value

For one stratum a data frame with columns pat_id, stratum_name, stratum, block_number, arm, permute.block (only when IDs are permuted) and RanNo; for several strata a named list of such data frames, where the first column is called pat_id.stratum. The attribute "rando_info" records the seed, RNG settings, R and package versions and the design arguments.

See also

check_rando_list, write_rando_list, check_final_setup

Examples

x <- createRandoList(nPat = 40, arm_names = dummy_arm_names(c("Dex", "Pla"), TRUE),
                     blocklength = c(4, 6), blocklength_prob = c(0.75, 0.25),
                     seed = 20261104)
head(x)
#>   pat_id stratum_name stratum block_number       arm  RanNo
#> 1     01          HTD     001            1 Dex_Dummy 001-01
#> 2     02          HTD     001            1 Pla_Dummy 001-02
#> 3     03          HTD     001            1 Pla_Dummy 001-03
#> 4     04          HTD     001            1 Pla_Dummy 001-04
#> 5     05          HTD     001            1 Dex_Dummy 001-05
#> 6     06          HTD     001            1 Dex_Dummy 001-06
check_rando_list(x)
#> Randomisation list check: OK
#> 
#>  stratum  n                       arms n_blocks block_sizes
#>      HTD 40 Dex_Dummy=20; Pla_Dummy=20        8    4x4; 6x3
#>  complete_blocks_balanced last_block_balanced
#>                      TRUE                TRUE

# stratified
s <- composite_strata(site = c(HCMC = "1", HN = "2"), age = c(Child = "C", Adult = "A"))
y <- createRandoList(nPat = 20, strata = s, blocklength = c(4, 6),
                     blocklength_prob = c(0.75, 0.25), seed = 1)
names(y)
#> [1] "HCMC.Child" "HN.Child"   "HCMC.Adult" "HN.Adult"
